::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 10th [1884]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/  Yonge 1884/ 1
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

I am terribly bound up with present matters of necessity but I will hunt up [Delicia](other_books/otherbook_959.qmd) and see what I can do with her, though I know May, June & July are pretty full  But I will put her in type, and then she will be sure of getting in soon (after Magazine calculation of soon)

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Carter Smith had evidently complained about the non-appearance of 'Delicia Darling', which did not in fact appear in [*MP*](organizations/other_52.qmd) until August 1886.
